profiles.description: Sporting records as published: corrections kept as revisions, tables replayed and compared with the published table, identities reviewed, no odds or predictions

workflow_defaults.knowledge_cutoff: the end of the match date unless stated
workflow_defaults.table_comparison: always against the nearest source-published table; disagreements listed
workflow_defaults.forecast_resolution: official, corrected or forfeit_awarded revisions only
workflow_defaults.unmatched_names: shown as the source string, marked unmatched

vocabulary.revision: one publication of a fixture's schedule or result
vocabulary.correction: an official result that differs from an earlier official one in the source's own date order
vocabulary.table: a replay from recorded results under the stated rule, beside the source's own table

requires.reason: the bundle's own entry points use these operations
Olympic result revisions are part of the core bundle
sources, licences and budgets are declared in the sports-records source pack
accepted and reverted matches and club lineage are entity identity decisions
venues resolve to Geospatial places through reviewable place resolutions
news coverage of matches and transfers is linked by reviewable candidates

optional_features.description: Cross-source identity review: players, teams and competitions from different sources are proposed into the shared reviewable identity state machine (Corporate Ownership's ownership.identity) and linked only by accepted, reversible decisions. Off by default so the Sports bundle never makes Corporate Ownership mandatory; without it every record stays its source's own record.

requires.reason: player, team and competition matches use the reviewable identity state machine

optional_features.description: Tennis match results from Jeff Sackmann's archives under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (licence-gated per the SP01 audit): non-commercial deployments only, attribution and share-alike on every record and export, commercial exports refused.
